einzeiler: Fantasy Football Week 2 Trade Advice and Player Q&A
kurzfassung: Chris Welsh and Andrew Erickson answer fantasy football trade questions for Week 2. They discuss injury news, buy-low opportunities, and sell-high targets. The hosts also review roster construction strategies and specific player deals.
stichpunkte: Latest injury news and fantasy fallout
Buy-low targets including Colston Loveland, Garrett Wilson, and Terry McLaurin
Blockbuster trade evaluations for players like Christian McCaffrey, Nico Collins, and Brock Bowers
Roster construction versus pure player value
Panic checks on players such as Jaylen Waddle and A.J. Brown
Rapid-fire trade verdicts and lineup decisions for Week 2
beschreibung:
Chris Welsh and Andrew Erickson answer your biggest Week 2 fantasy football trade questions, starting with the latest injury news before breaking down buy-low opportunities like Colston Loveland, Garrett Wilson and Terry McLaurin.
The guys tackle blockbuster deals involving Christian McCaffrey, Chase Brown, Jameer Gibbs, Kenneth Walker III, Nico Collins, Brock Bowers, Malik Nabers and Puka Nacua while explaining when roster construction should outweigh pure player value.
Plus, get panic checks on Jaylen Waddle and A.J. Brown, rapid-fire trade verdicts, late injury fallout and advice on De'Von Achane, James Cook, Justin Jefferson, Ja'Marr Chase and more before setting your Week 2 lineup
